proof: Push-to-Talk in the mobile pult, end to end on this PC
chain: real Chrome (headless, fake microphone playing a Windows-TTS Russian phrase, no human voice) -> hold the mic button (MediaRecorder) -> mobile pult :8842 -> ffmpeg to 16 kHz mono WAV -> candidate Bossman :8811 /api/oss/speech/transcribe -> local faster-whisper (CPU, no cloud) -> text in the input

result.text_in_input: Открой блокноты напишу привет мир. Открой блокноты напишу...
result.spoken_phrase: Открой блокнот и напиши привет мир

defect_found_by_this_proof: the first live run answered 405: Bossman's route is /api/oss/speech/transcribe, not /api/speech/transcribe. The unit tests had passed because the fake Bossman mirrored the same wrong path. Fixed in the endpoint, the fake and the tests.
also_found: ffmpeg writes a WAV to a pipe with unfinished sizes in the header and Whisper rejects it: fix_wav_sizes() rewrites them
the fake microphone loops the file, so the phrase appears twice
accuracy_note: Whisper base-multilingual made 2 word errors in 7 (блокноты/напишу): larger models are installed (D:\Bossman\models\voice\whisper aster-whisper-large-v3-turbo) and can be selected with BOSSMAN_WHISPER_MODEL_PATH; not measured here.
tests: 7 new + the whole mobile suite 317 passed
not_proven: a real phone: getUserMedia needs https (tailscale serve) or localhost, iOS Safari MP4/AAC was not tried, a human voice and noise were not tried; the owner's live pult :8840 still runs the old build
